audit_status.source_base: Greek 2 Thessalonians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact draft reviewed for thanksgiving, growing trust/love, endurance under pressure, just judgment, relief, revelation of Lord Jesus, being made worthy of calling.

verses.restored: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the assembly of Thessalonians in Divine our Father and Lord Jesus Messiah:

familiar.text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

modern.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

original.text: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν θεῷ πατρὶ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ·

verses.restored: Grace to you and peace from Divine Father and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ ⸀πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

verses.restored: We ought always to give thanks to the Divine concerning you, siblings, as is fitting, because your trust is growing exceedingly and the love of each one of you all toward one another is increasing.

familiar.text: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

modern.text: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.

original.text: Εὐχαριστεῖν ὀφείλομεν τῷ θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀδελφοί, καθὼς ἄξιόν ἐστιν, ὅτι ὑπεραυξάνει ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν καὶ πλεονάζει ἡ ἀγάπη ἑνὸς ἑκάστου πάντων ὑμῶν εἰς ἀλλήλους,

verses.restored: So that we ourselves boast in you among the assemblies of the Divine for your endurance and trust in all your pursuits/persecutions and pressures that you are bearing.

familiar.text: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

modern.text: That is why we boast among God’s churches about your perseverance and faith in the face of all the persecution and affliction you are enduring. Christ’s Coming

original.text: ὥστε ⸂αὐτοὺς ἡμᾶς⸃ ἐν ὑμῖν ⸀ἐγκαυχᾶσθαι ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ τῆς ὑπομονῆς ὑμῶν καὶ πίστεως ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς διωγμοῖς ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς θλίψεσιν αἷς ἀνέχεσθε,

verses.restored: This is evidence of the righteous/just judgment of the Divine, so that you may be counted worthy of the reign of the Divine, for which you also suffer.

familiar.text: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

modern.text: All this is clear evidence of God’s righteous judgment. And so you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

original.text: ἔνδειγμα τῆς δικαίας κρίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς τὸ καταξιωθῆναι ὑμᾶς τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ θεοῦ, ὑπὲρ ἧς καὶ πάσχετε,

verses.restored: Since indeed it is righteous/just with the Divine to repay pressure to those pressuring you,

familiar.text: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

modern.text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,

original.text: εἴπερ δίκαιον παρὰ θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι τοῖς θλίβουσιν ὑμᾶς θλῖψιν

verses.restored: and relief to you who are pressured, with us, at the unveiling of the Lord Jesus from heaven with messengers of his power,

familiar.text: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

modern.text: and to grant relief to you who are oppressed and to us as well. This will take place when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with His mighty angels

original.text: καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς θλιβομένοις ἄνεσιν μεθʼ ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ ἀποκαλύψει τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἀπʼ οὐρανοῦ μετʼ ἀγγέλων δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

verses.restored: in flaming fire, giving justice concerning those not knowing the Divine and those not obeying the good news of our Lord Jesus.

familiar.text: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

modern.text: in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

original.text: ἐν ⸂φλογὶ πυρός⸃, διδόντος ἐκδίκησιν τοῖς μὴ εἰδόσι θεὸν καὶ τοῖς μὴ ὑπακούουσιν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ,

verses.restored: These will pay a penalty of age-long ruin away from the face/presence of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,

familiar.text: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

modern.text: They will suffer the penalty of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and the glory of His might,

original.text: οἵτινες δίκην τίσουσιν ὄλεθρον αἰώνιον ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ κυρίου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δόξης τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,

verses.restored: when he comes to be glorified in his holy ones and marveled at among all those who trusted, because our witness to you was trusted, in that day.

familiar.text: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

modern.text: on the day He comes to be glorified in His saints and regarded with wonder by all who have believed, including you who have believed our testimony.

original.text: ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐνδοξασθῆναι ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ καὶ θαυμασθῆναι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύσασιν, ὅτι ἐπιστεύθη τὸ μαρτύριον ἡμῶν ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ.

verses.restored: For this also we always pray concerning you, that our Divine may make you worthy of the calling and fulfill every good pleasure of goodness and work of trust in power,

familiar.text: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

modern.text: To this end, we always pray for you, that our God will count you worthy of His calling, and that He will powerfully fulfill your every good desire and work of faith,

original.text: εἰς ὃ καὶ προσευχόμεθα πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ἀξιώσῃ τῆς κλήσεως ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ πληρώσῃ πᾶσαν εὐδοκίαν ἀγαθωσύνης καὶ ἔργον πίστεως ἐν δυνάμει,

verses.restored: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our Divine and Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

modern.text: so that the name of our Lord Jesus will be glorified in you, and you in Him, according to the grace of our God and of the Lord Jesus Christ.

original.text: ὅπως ἐνδοξασθῇ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ ἐν ὑμῖν, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν αὐτῷ, κατὰ τὴν χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

translation_notes: Judgment imagery is preserved as apocalyptic justice for oppressed believers, not permission for human vengeance.
Aionios is rendered age-long where appropriate to preserve the age-related semantic range.
The chapter's pastoral purpose is endurance, relief, and worthiness of calling under pressure.
